Kullanıcı yalnızca seçilen birimlerin (v: The user sees only the labs and computers of the selected units (and their sub-units), and no unassigned computers.
Kullanıcı bütün sınıfları ve bilgisayarl: The user sees all labs and computers.
Birim yok: bütün kullanıcılar her şeyi g: No units: every user sees everything.
Bunları ve atanmamış bilgisayarları yaln: Only accounts without a scope see these and the unassigned computers.
Sınıfları birimsiz kalır; bu birim kulla: Its labs are left without a unit, and the unit is removed from user and token scopes (an account whose scope becomes empty sees nothing). A unit with sub-units cannot be deleted.
Bir ilçe birçok okulu bu sunucudan yönet: If a district manages several schools from this server, set up units (district, school), put the labs into units and give users a scope. A user with a scope sees only the labs and computers of their units. Until units are set up, everyone sees everything.
Örn. Merkez İlçe MEM ya da Atatürk Anado: e.g. Central District Education Office or Atatürk High School
Okul bir ilçenin altına konur; üst birim: A school goes under a district; a parent unit's scope includes its sub-units.
Başka bir birimdeki sınıfı seçerseniz o: Choosing a lab that is in another unit moves it here. A lab you clear is left without a unit: only accounts without a scope see it.
Bir birim seçilirse jeton yalnızca o bir: With a unit, the token sees only the computers of that unit (and its sub-units).
Kapsam: eşlemeyle açılan hesabın gördüğü: Scope: the units an account opened by this mapping sees. An account that first signs in through a mapping without a scope sees no unit until you choose one.
